layout.body:
Springfield Community Wellness
Classes - Special Addition
Due to popular demand, guided stretching sessions will take place in Central Park every Saturday at 8:00 A.M., well before the start time of other weekend classes.
Stretching boosts flexibility, reduces tension, and improves circulation.
Bring a mat and a water bottle,
Free for residents!

questions.stem: What is indicated about the special sessions?

options.A: They will be held twice a month.
options.B: They are required for those who take other weekend classes.
options.C: They are free for anyone who would like to participate.
options.D: They are being offered in response to community interest.

questions.analysis: What is indicated about the special sessions? 原文依据：Due to popular demand, guided stretching sessions will take place… 翻译：应大众需求，开设拉伸指导课程。 选项分析： (A) They will be held twice a month. 每月举办两次 → 错误，原文为 every Saturday 每周六，无半月一次表述 (B) They are required for those who take other weekend classes. 选修其他周末课必须参加 → 错误，原文无强制要求相关内容 (C) They are free for anyone who would like to participate. 所有参与者免费 → 错误，限定为 Free for residents 仅限居民免费 (D) They are being offered in response to community interest. 因社区民众需求而开设 → 正确，due to popular demand 对应社区大众需求

questions.stem: What is NOT mentioned about stretching?
questions.analysis: What is NOT mentioned about stretching? 原文依据：Stretching boosts flexibility, reduces tension, and improves circulation. 翻译：拉伸能提升柔韧性、缓解紧绷感、促进血液循环。 选项分析： (A) It improves flexibility. 提升柔韧性 → 原文提及，排除 (B) It helps relieve tension. 缓解身心紧张 → 原文提及，排除 (C) It builds muscle strength. 增强肌肉力量 → 原文未提及，符合题意 (D) It enhances circulation. 促进血液循环 → 原文提及，排除
